Reading every kind when the judge never answers is the documented design ("The judge's answer stands whatever it leaves out, short of everything"), and the finding only objected to the silence, which does not exist. One narrow residual, not the finding's scenario: on a sidecar resume `ingest()` resets `flags = []` (line 1941) and `checkpointed()` returns only the excluded kinds, so a run stopped after triage and resumed would drop the flag from the completion record even though the sidecar's first row stored it; the battery has no check for the None-reply path either.
